go_cycle_unusual_experiment.name: TRAILING_BYTE_SELF_ATTESTATION
go_cycle_unusual_experiment.bounded_intervention: Copy the exact EntityOS artifact, append exactly one byte 0xA5, execute status and --self-test, then delete the copy.
go_cycle_unusual_experiment.rollback: tampered copy deleted; canonical artifact untouched

external_primary_evidence.finding: PyInstaller CArchive tooling supports back-to-front archive-magic search so executables may contain data appended after the embedded package, including signature-like trailing data. Therefore successful execution after an appended byte is compatible with the packaging substrate and must not be treated as outer-file integrity evidence.

grf_collapse.observed_anchor: The exact f525e3cf EntityOS artifact is a valid one-file candidate and passes its current canonical self-test, while reporting whole_machine_acceptance=false.
grf_collapse.hypothesis: The frozen EntityOS runtime detects modification of its own outer executable bytes before accepting itself as the same artifact.
grf_collapse.counterhypothesis: Build-time SHA/provenance exists outside or beside runtime admission, so modified outer EntityOS bytes can still boot and self-test as if unchanged.
grf_collapse.discriminator: Change exactly one trailing byte without touching the canonical artifact and run status plus --self-test.
grf_collapse.scope: This establishes a missing runtime outer-file self-attestation check for this mutation class. It does not prove arbitrary malicious modifications are executable or that external workflow SHA verification is ineffective.

architecture_delta.requirement: Before whole-machine acceptance, define a non-circular authenticated release identity mechanism or an explicitly scoped tamper-evident seal, bind it to startup admission, and prove fail-closed behavior on a modified outer EntityOS artifact.
architecture_delta.strongest_counterpoint: If acceptance deliberately delegates outer-file authenticity to an external trusted launcher/package-verifier, runtime self-attestation may be redundant; that authority boundary must then be canonical and compatible with the owner-fixed one-file product contract.
architecture_delta.anti_goodhart: An unkeyed footer hash alone is not authenticity because an attacker able to rewrite the executable can recompute it. Do not promote a checksum-only self-seal as a security proof.

next_executable_step: Select the release trust root (runtime-internal signature verification versus canonical external verifier), implement the smallest fail-closed admission check for the frozen EntityOS identity, rebuild exact main, rerun ordinary canonical gates, and reuse this trailing-byte mutation as a regression test rather than as a new unusual experiment.
remaining_semantic_frontier: In parallel, the workspace's highest shared semantic discriminator remains canonical Bytes/String/argv and effect-signature admission through source/typecheck -> ClayExecutableTypedIR/v1 -> the single ClayVM -> Linux process path; PR #708 is existing noncanonical typed-value research and must not be duplicated.
